test-set.name: severity-role-flag
test-set.description: The severity attribute, and role, flag and severity whose values are evaluated (variable references and attribute value templates).

test-case.name: severity-static
test-case.description: severity is part of a finding.

finding.message: A severity outside the reserved values.

test-case.name: severity-with-role-and-flag
test-case.description: severity, role and flag together; each is reported as written.

test-case.name: role-variable
test-case.description: A role that is a variable reference is evaluated.

test-case.name: flag-variable
test-case.description: A flag that is a variable reference is evaluated; the evaluated name is raised.

test-case.name: severity-variable
test-case.description: A severity that is a variable reference is evaluated.

test-case.name: role-phase-variable
test-case.description: A role varying with the selected phase through a phase variable.

test-case.name: role-avt
test-case.description: Under xslt3 an attribute value template may compute role.

test-case.name: flag-avt
test-case.description: Under xslt3 an attribute value template may compute flag.

test-case.name: severity-avt
test-case.description: Under xslt3 an attribute value template may compute severity.

test-case.name: role-avt-xslt2
test-case.description: Under xslt2 too, an attribute value template may compute role.

test-case.name: rule-flag-variable
test-case.description: A rule's flag that is a variable reference is evaluated when the rule fires.

test-case.name: role-literal
test-case.description: Only a role that is a variable reference is evaluated: other text is reported as written.

test-case.name: role-variable-empty
test-case.description: A role that is a variable reference whose value is the empty sequence.

result.implementation-defined: role is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.14 does not say what a finding carries when the value is the empty sequence. Readings: no role, an empty one, or an error. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: role-variable-several
test-case.description: A role that is a variable reference whose value is two strings.

result.implementation-defined: role is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.14 does not say what a finding carries when the value is two strings. Readings: the strings joined with a space, the first, or an error. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: role-variable-not-a-name
test-case.description: A role that is a variable reference whose value is a string that is not a name.

result.implementation-defined: role is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.14 does not say what a finding carries when the value is a string that is not a name. 5.5.14 calls the value a name; readings: the string as it is, or an error. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: severity-variable-empty
test-case.description: A severity that is a variable reference whose value is the empty sequence.

result.implementation-defined: severity is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.16 does not say what a finding carries when the value is the empty sequence. Readings: no severity, an empty one, or an error. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: severity-variable-several
test-case.description: A severity that is a variable reference whose value is two strings.

result.implementation-defined: severity is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.16 does not say what a finding carries when the value is two strings. Readings: the strings joined with a space, the first, or an error. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: severity-variable-not-a-name
test-case.description: A severity that is a variable reference whose value is a string that is not a name.

result.implementation-defined: severity is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.16 does not say what a finding carries when the value is a string that is not a name. 5.5.16 calls the value a name; readings: the string as it is, or an error. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: flag-variable-empty
test-case.description: A flag that is a variable reference whose value is the empty sequence.

result.implementation-defined: flag is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.6 does not say what a finding carries when the value is the empty sequence. Readings: no flag, an empty one, or an error. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: flag-variable-several
test-case.description: A flag that is a variable reference whose value is two strings.

result.implementation-defined: flag is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.6 does not say what a finding carries when the value is two strings. Readings: the strings joined with a space, the first, or an error. A flag is a list of names (Annex A), so a flag may also raise each name. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: flag-variable-not-a-name
test-case.description: A flag that is a variable reference whose value is a string that is not a name.

result.implementation-defined: flag is evaluated dynamically, but 5.5.6 does not say what a finding carries when the value is a string that is not a name. 5.5.6 calls the value a name; readings: the string as it is, or an error. The finding itself is a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with the message One.

test-case.name: severity-static-not-a-name
test-case.description: A severity written in the schema that is not a name.

result.implementation-defined: 5.5.16 calls a severity a name, but Annex A types it as text and 7.2 lists only flag, id, name and prefix as attributes that shall be names: a processor may reject the schema or report a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with severity 'very high'.

test-case.name: role-static-not-a-name
test-case.description: A role written in the schema that is not a name.

result.implementation-defined: 5.5.14 calls a role a name, but Annex A types it as a string and 7.2 does not list role among the attributes that shall be names: a processor may reject the schema or report a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with role 'business rule'.

test-case.name: role-variable-attribute-node
test-case.description: A role variable whose value is an attribute node: the role is the node's string value (the reading the suite takes; role is a string in the report).

test-case.name: role-variable-undefined
test-case.description: A role written as a reference to a variable that no let defines.

result.implementation-defined: 5.4.7 makes a reference to an undefined variable an error, but Annex J treats a $ not followed by the name of an in-scope variable as a literal character: a processor may reject the schema, end in error, or report a successful-report at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[1] with role '$missing'.

test-case.name: severity-on-rule
test-case.description: severity belongs to assert and report; a rule has none.

test-case.name: severity-on-pattern
test-case.description: severity belongs to assert and report; a pattern has none.

test-case.name: role-on-pattern-not-inherited
test-case.description: A pattern's role is not the role of its assertions' findings.

test-case.name: rule-role-variable
test-case.description: A rule's role that is a reference to the rule's own variable is evaluated for each context node; it is the role of the fired rule, not of the findings.

test-case.name: flag-phase-variable
test-case.description: A flag that refers to a phase variable takes the value of the selected phase.

test-case.name: severity-abstract-parameter
test-case.description: severity written as $sev in an abstract pattern whose instance gives a parameter sev.

result.implementation-defined: 6.2 replaces parameters only in attributes that contain queries, and 5.5.16 evaluates a severity only when it is a variable reference: whether $sev is a parameter reference (severity 'error' on a failed-assert at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[2], message Not two.) or a reference to an undefined variable (an error) is not decided.

test-case.name: role-abstract-parameter
test-case.description: role written as $r in an abstract pattern whose instance gives a parameter r.

result.implementation-defined: Whether role is an attribute that contains a query, in which 6.2 replaces parameters (role 'business' on a failed-assert at /Q{}doc[1]/Q{}item[2], message Not two.), or text reported as written ('$r'), or a variable reference to an undefined variable (an error), is not decided.

test-case.name: rule-flag-rule-variable
test-case.description: A rule's flag that refers to the rule's own variable: each evaluated name is raised when the rule fires.
